# gyro_app_install (Resource)

Installs a one-click app on a cloud server. WARNING: the server disk is rebuilt. Destroy only forgets the install (the server keeps running).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# WARNING: installing an app rebuilds the server disk
resource "gyro_app_install" "wp" {
  server_id = tonumber(gyro_server.web.id)
  app       = "wordpress"
  domain    = "blog.example.com"
  email     = "admin@example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app` (String) App id from GET /cloud/apps.
- `server_id` (Number)

### Optional

- `domain` (String)
- `email` (String)
- `os` (String)

### Read-Only

- `credentials` (Map of String, Sensitive)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `status` (String)
- `url` (String)
